name: Camping 101: Herbalism

angles.text: As an herbalist, you can use gathered plants for wilderness survival as well as alchemy, making camp supplies such as Incense Candles.
As an Alliance herbalist near Teldrassil, you can learn fieldcraft from local night elf practitioners in Dolanaar.
As a night elf, you share a tradition of understanding the restorative properties of nature's herbs, taught in settlements such as Dolanaar.

faq.answer: Skilled herbalists travel to Malorne Bladeleaf in Dolanaar to learn how to make camp goods from gathered plants.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?

faq.answer: An Incense Candle lifts spirits and creates a soothing, focused atmosphere around a campfire.
faq.q: What does an Incense Candle do for a camp?

faq.answer: Malorne Bladeleaf teaches skilled herbalists in Dolanaar to make camp supplies, including Incense Candles.
You travel to Dolanaar, a night elf settlement on Teldrassil and a hub for travelers, trainers, and woodland crafters.
faq.q: Where does this quest take you?

faq.answer: An Incense Candle creates a serene, focused place where healers and spellcasters can restore their spirits and magical strength during wilderness journeys.
faq.q: Why are Incense Candles useful to magic users?

aliases: when can i learn incense candle
faq.answer: You need enough practical skill in herbalism before Malorne Bladeleaf will teach you to make camp supplies.
faq.q: What is required before Malorne Bladeleaf will teach you?

sections.body: Herbalism can serve a traveler beyond gathering flowers for sale or for alchemists. In the wilderness, harvested plants can become useful camp equipment. Preparing them for survival lets your gathered plants support longer journeys in the field.
sections.title: More Than Picking Flowers

sections.body: At Dolanaar, Malorne Bladeleaf teaches skilled herbalists to make an Incense Candle. Its soothing flame creates a focused, high-spirited refuge around the campfire. Healers and spellcasters value its revitalizing presence as they restore their magical energies between perils.
sections.title: The Soothing Flame of Dolanaar

summary: In Dolanaar, herbalists learn to make camp goods from the plants they gather. Malorne Bladeleaf teaches skilled gatherers to craft Incense Candles, which bolster healers and spellcasters by the campfire.
